sysmapid.description: ID of the map. Parameter behavior: read-only; required for update operations.

height.description: Height of the map in pixels. Parameter behavior: required for create operations.

name.description: Name of the map. Parameter behavior: required for create operations.

width.description: Width of the map in pixels. Parameter behavior: required for create operations.

backgroundid.description: ID of the image used as the background for the map.

expand_macros.description: Whether to expand macros in labels when configuring the map. Possible values: 0 - (default) do not expand macros; 1 - expand macros.

expandproblem.description: Whether the problem trigger will be displayed for elements with a single problem. Possible values: 0 - always display the number of problems; 1 - (default) display the problem trigger if there's only one problem.

grid_align.description: Whether to enable grid aligning. Possible values: 0 - disable grid aligning; 1 - (default) enable grid aligning.

grid_show.description: Whether to show the grid on the map. Possible values: 0 - do not show the grid; 1 - (default) show the grid.

grid_size.description: Size of the map grid in pixels. Supported values: 20, 40, 50, 75 and 100. Default: 50.

highlight.description: Whether icon highlighting is enabled. Possible values: 0 - highlighting disabled; 1 - (default) highlighting enabled.

iconmapid.description: ID of the icon map used on the map.

label_format.description: Whether to enable advanced labels. Possible values: 0 - (default) disable advanced labels; 1 - enable advanced labels.

label_location.description: Location of the map element label. Possible values: 0 - (default) bottom; 1 - left; 2 - right; 3 - top.

label_string_host.description: Custom label for host elements. Parameter behavior: required if label_type_host is set to "custom" (5).

label_string_hostgroup.description: Custom label for host group elements. Parameter behavior: required if label_type_hostgroup is set to "custom" (5).

label_string_image.description: Custom label for image elements. Parameter behavior: required if label_type_image is set to "custom" (5).

label_string_map.description: Custom label for map elements. Parameter behavior: required if label_type_map is set to "custom" (5).

label_string_trigger.description: Custom label for trigger elements. Parameter behavior: required if label_type_trigger is set to "custom" (5).

label_type.description: Map element label type. Possible values: 0 - label; 1 - IP address; 2 - (default) element name; 3 - status only; 4 - nothing.

label_type_host.description: Label type for host elements. Possible values: 0 - label; 1 - IP address; 2 - (default) element name; 3 - status only; 4 - nothing; 5 - custom.

label_type_hostgroup.description: Label type for host group elements. Possible values: 0 - label; 2 - (default) element name; 3 - status only; 4 - nothing; 5 - custom.

label_type_image.description: Label type for image elements. Possible values: 0 - label; 2 - (default) element name; 4 - nothing; 5 - custom.

label_type_map.description: Label type for map elements. Possible values: 0 - label; 2 - (default) element name; 3 - status only; 4 - nothing; 5 - custom.

label_type_trigger.description: Label type for trigger elements. Possible values: 0 - label; 2 - (default) element name; 3 - status only; 4 - nothing; 5 - custom.

markelements.description: Whether to highlight map elements that have recently changed their status. Possible values: 0 - (default) do not highlight elements; 1 - highlight elements.

severity_min.description: Minimum severity of the triggers that will be displayed on the map. Same values as the trigger object's priority (severity) property: 0 - not classified; 1 - information; 2 - warning; 3 - average; 4 - high; 5 - disaster.

show_unack.description: How problems should be displayed. Possible values: 0 - (default) display the count of all problems; 1 - display only the count of unacknowledged problems; 2 - display the count of acknowledged and unacknowledged problems separately.

userid.description: ID of the user that is the owner of the map.

private.description: Type of map sharing. Possible values: 0 - public map; 1 - (default) private map.

show_suppressed.description: Whether suppressed problems are shown. Possible values: 0 - (default) hide suppressed problems; 1 - show suppressed problems.

links.description: Map links to replace the existing links.

selements.description: Map elements to replace the existing elements.

urls.description: Map URLs to replace the existing URLs.

users.description: Map user shares to replace the existing elements.

userGroups.description: Map user group shares to replace the existing elements.

shapes.description: Map shapes to replace the existing shapes.

lines.description: Map lines to replace the existing lines.

mapElementHostRef.description: Map element Host object. Defines one host element (used when selement.elementtype = 0).

mapElementHostGroupRef.description: Map element Host group object. Defines one host group element (used when selement.elementtype = 3).

mapElementMapRef.description: Map element Map object. Defines one map element (used when selement.elementtype = 1).

mapElementTriggerRef.description: Map element Trigger object. Defines one trigger element; a selement may reference one or more of these (used when selement.elementtype = 2).

mapElementTag.description: Map element Tag object. Defines a tag-based filtering condition for a map element (used with host group elements). Note: this property is not listed in the 'Map element' property table on the Zabbix docs, but is documented as its own object and is returned as the selement 'tags' array in map.get example responses; included here for fidelity to the observed API shape.

tag.description: Map element tag name. Parameter behavior: required.

operator.description: Map element tag condition operator. Possible values: 0 - (default) Contains; 1 - Equals; 2 - Does not contain; 3 - Does not equal; 4 - Exists; 5 - Does not exist.

mapElementUrl.description: Map element URL object. Defines a clickable link available for a specific map element.

selementid.description: ID of the map element that the URL belongs to.

mapSelement.description: Map element object. Defines an object displayed on a map.

selementid.description: ID of the map element. Normally read-only/server-generated. When creating a map, may be set to an arbitrary temporary value so it can be referenced from a link's selementid1/selementid2 in the same request; Zabbix replaces it with the real generated ID.

elementtype.description: Type of map element. Possible values: 0 - host; 1 - map; 2 - trigger; 3 - host group; 4 - image. Parameter behavior: required.

iconid_off.description: ID of the image used to display the element in default state. Parameter behavior: required.

elements.description: Element data object(s) - the shape depends on elementtype (host/host group/map ref, or one or more trigger refs). Parameter behavior: required if elementtype is set to "host", "map", "trigger" or "host group".

areatype.description: How separate host group hosts should be displayed. Possible values: 0 - (default) the host group element will take up the whole map; 1 - the host group element will have a fixed size.

elementsubtype.description: How a host group element should be displayed on a map. Possible values: 0 - (default) display the host group as a single element; 1 - display each host in the group separately.

evaltype.description: Map element tag filtering condition evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - (default) And/Or; 2 - Or.

height.description: Height of the fixed size host group element in pixels. Default: 200.

iconid_disabled.description: ID of the image used to display disabled map elements. Parameter behavior: supported if elementtype is set to "host", "map", "trigger", or "host group".

iconid_maintenance.description: ID of the image used to display map elements in maintenance. Parameter behavior: supported if elementtype is set to "host", "map", "trigger", or "host group".

iconid_on.description: ID of the image used to display map elements with problems. Parameter behavior: supported if elementtype is set to "host", "map", "trigger", or "host group".

label_location.description: Location of the map element label. Possible values: -1 - (default) default location; 0 - bottom; 1 - left; 2 - right; 3 - top.

permission.description: Type of permission level. Possible values: -1 - none; 2 - read only; 3 - read-write.

tags.description: Map element tag filter conditions (see note on mapElementTag).

use_iconmap.description: Whether icon mapping must be used for host elements. Possible values: 0 - do not use icon mapping; 1 - (default) use icon mapping.

viewtype.description: Host group element placing algorithm. Possible values: 0 - (default) grid.

width.description: Width of the fixed size host group element in pixels. Default: 200.

x.description: X-coordinates of the element in pixels. Default: 0.

y.description: Y-coordinates of the element in pixels. Default: 0.

mapLinkTrigger.description: Map link trigger object. Defines a map link status indicator based on the state of a trigger.

triggerid.description: ID of the trigger used as a link indicator. Parameter behavior: required.

color.description: Indicator color as a hexadecimal color code. Default: DD0000.

drawtype.description: Indicator draw style. Possible values: 0 - (default) line; 2 - bold line; 3 - dotted line; 4 - dashed line.

linkid.description: ID of the map link that the link trigger belongs to.

mapLink.description: Map link object. Defines a link between two map elements.

selementid1.description: ID of the first map element linked on one end. Parameter behavior: required.

selementid2.description: ID of the first map element linked on the other end. Parameter behavior: required.

color.description: Line color as a hexadecimal color code. Default: 000000.

drawtype.description: Link line draw style. Possible values: 0 - (default) line; 2 - bold line; 3 - dotted line; 4 - dashed line.

linktriggers.description: Map link triggers to use as link status indicators.

permission.description: Type of permission level. Possible values: -1 - none; 2 - read only; 3 - read-write.

sysmapid.description: ID of the map the link belongs to.

mapUrl.description: Map URL object. Defines a clickable link available for all elements of a specific type on the map.

elementtype.description: Type of map element for which the URL will be available. Possible values (see the map element elementtype property): 0 - host; 1 - map; 2 - trigger; 3 - host group; 4 - image. Default: 0.

sysmapid.description: ID of the map that the URL belongs to.

mapUser.description: Map user object. List of map permissions based on users.

userid.description: ID of the user. Parameter behavior: required.

permission.description: Type of permission level. Possible values: 2 - read only; 3 - read-write. Parameter behavior: required.

mapUserGroup.description: Map user group object. List of map permissions based on user groups.

usrgrpid.description: ID of the user group. Parameter behavior: required.

permission.description: Type of permission level. Possible values: 2 - read only; 3 - read-write. Parameter behavior: required.

mapShape.description: Map shape object. Defines a geometric shape (with or without text) displayed on a map.

type.description: Type of map shape element. Possible values: 0 - rectangle; 1 - ellipse. Property is required when new shapes are created. Parameter behavior: required.

x.description: X-coordinates of the shape in pixels. Default: 0.

y.description: Y-coordinates of the shape in pixels. Default: 0.

width.description: Width of the shape in pixels. Default: 200.

height.description: Height of the shape in pixels. Default: 200.

font.description: Font of the text within shape. Possible values: 0 - Georgia, serif; 1 - "Palatino Linotype", "Book Antiqua", Palatino, serif; 2 - "Times New Roman", Times, serif; 3 - Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; 4 - "Arial Black", Gadget, sans-serif; 5 - "Comic Sans MS", cursive, sans-serif; 6 - Impact, Charcoal, sans-serif; 7 - "Lucida Sans Unicode", "Lucida Grande", sans-serif; 8 - Tahoma, Geneva, sans-serif; 9 - "Trebuchet MS", Helvetica, sans-serif; 10 - Verdana, Geneva, sans-serif; 11 - "Courier New", Courier, monospace; 12 - "Lucida Console", Monaco, monospace. Default: 9.

text_halign.description: Horizontal alignment of text. Possible values: 0 - center; 1 - left; 2 - right. Default: 0.

text_valign.description: Vertical alignment of text. Possible values: 0 - middle; 1 - top; 2 - bottom. Default: 0.

border_type.description: Type of the border. Possible values: 0 - none; 1 - solid line; 2 - dotted line; 3 - dashed line. Default: 0.

border_width.description: Width of the border in pixels. Default: 0.

zindex.description: Value used to order all shapes and lines (z-index). Default: 0.

mapLine.description: Map line object. Defines a line displayed on a map.

x1.description: X-coordinates of the line point 1 in pixels. Default: 0.

y1.description: Y-coordinates of the line point 1 in pixels. Default: 0.

x2.description: X-coordinates of the line point 2 in pixels. Default: 200.

y2.description: Y-coordinates of the line point 2 in pixels. Default: 200.

line_type.description: Type of the lines. Possible values: 0 - none; 1 - solid line; 2 - dotted line; 3 - dashed line. Default: 0.

line_width.description: Width of the lines in pixels. Default: 0.

zindex.description: Value used to order all shapes and lines (z-index). Default: 0.
